'''Takeminawake no Mikoto''' (武美名別命) is a figure from ancient Japan.

== Overview ==
Takeminawake no Mikoto is considered the same deity as '''Takemizuwake Ōkami''' (武水別大神), worshipped at {{ill|Takemizuwake Shrine|ja|武水別神社}}, a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|式内社|lt=Shikinaisha}} mentioned in Volumes 9 and 10 of the {{ill|Engishiki|en|Engishiki|qid=Q1342448|lt=Engishiki}}. This shrine is located in the former {{ill|Sarashina District, Nagano|en|Sarashina District, Nagano|qid=Q7423207|lt=Sarashina District}}, {{ill|Shinano Province|en|Shinano Province|qid=Q289250|lt=Shinano Province}}.

== Shrines ==
* {{ill|Takemizuwake Shrine|ja|武水別神社}} ({{ill|Chikuma, Nagano|en|Chikuma, Nagano|qid=Q179757|lt=Chikuma, Nagano}}, Nagano Prefecture)
* {{ill|Hijiri Shrine|ja|樋知大神社}} ({{ill|Nagano (city)|en|Nagano (city)|qid=Q128849|lt=Nagano, Nagano}}, Nagano Prefecture)
